Definition: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon)
BiblicalUsage: To adorn, to deck oneself with ornaments — adah is the verb of dressing up. The bride "adorneth herself with her jewels" in Isaiah's song of salvation; Jerusalem "deckest thee with ornaments of gold" to seduce her lovers in Jeremiah; and God says to Jerusalem, "I decked thee also with ornaments." The same verb dresses the bride, the harlot, and the beloved city.
TheologicalSignificance: Adorning is a picture with two faces in these verses, and the word itself is neutral — God dresses His people in salvation, and sin dresses itself for seduction.
